findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: Synchronous connection open and transaction calls inside an async ASP.NET Core request path
findings.recommendation: Type the connection as DbConnection and use OpenAsync, BeginTransactionAsync, CommitAsync and RollbackAsync with the cancellation token.

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: Connection and transaction aren't disposed and the connection isn't released if Open or BeginTransaction fails

evidence.excerpt: var connection = CreateConnection(...); ... connection.Open(); var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction();

findings.recommendation: Wrap the connection and transaction in using/await using declarations so they return to the pool on every path, including failures before the inner try.
